local_attempt.note: Step 1 (data load) failed with a syntax error; recovered on retry, but the RDD/causal estimation step then failed with 'infinite or NaN values in the exogenous variables' — plausibly the source CSV's pre-computed `*fitted` columns (allfitted, internalfitted, etc.) or a running-variable transform producing non-finite values near the age-21 cutoff. Never produced an estimate; only exploratory distribution plots. See notes.md.

estimate.note: GADS canonical from cloud reference run (drafted lane, sharp RDD via OLS with robust SE): +7.66, p=1.78e-09, correct DIRECTION (turning 21 increases mortality, matching QRData's positive gold of 0.10). Magnitude is roughly 77x the gold and NOT scored against a tolerance (tol: null) — see notes.md for the likely cause (full-sample RDD vs. the gold's ages-20-22-only restriction) and a units-labeling inconsistency in the run's own report.
